description_en: Creates a knowledge base in a specified workspace of the current tenant, and persistently binds the trusted tenantId and workspaceId. The creation process is asynchronous, and the response returns the resource status. You can query the status and lastError by calling GetKnowledgeBase or ListKnowledgeBases
description_zh: 在当前租户的指定工作空间中创建知识库，持久化绑定可信 tenantId 和 workspaceId。创建为异步过程，响应返回资源状态；通过 GetKnowledgeBase 或 ListKnowledgeBases 查询 status 和 lastError
name: CreateKnowledgeBase

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID is resolved from the trusted gateway call identity by Magic, and the workspace ownership is verified. The knowledge base is created or accessed within this tenant and workspace. Cross-tenant queries cannot be performed solely by using the knowledgeBaseId
parameters.help_zh: 由 Magic 从可信网关调用身份解析 tenantId 并校验工作空间归属；知识库在该租户及工作空间内创建或访问，不能仅凭 knowledgeBaseId 跨租户查询
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The optional idempotency token for the creation request. If provided, it must be a non-blank string with a maximum length of 128 characters. Within the same workspace, the same token and the same request return the original result, while different requests return IdempotencyConflict. If not provided, each request is processed as a new request, and idempotency across request retries is not guaranteed. Creation with the same name is still subject to the name uniqueness constraint
parameters.help_zh: 可选的创建请求幂等标识。提供时须为非空白字符串，最长 128 个字符；同一工作空间内相同标识和相同请求返回原结果，不同请求返回 IdempotencyConflict。未提供时每次按新请求处理，不保证跨请求重试幂等；同名创建仍受名称唯一性约束
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: Required when the strategy is BY_HEADING, and the value ranges from 1 to 6. Headings at or below this level are used as boundaries. Deeper headings are retained in the body text. Overlong sections fall back to paragraphs or sentences, and documents without headings fall back to intelligent chunking. Ignored for other strategies and verified by the backend according to the strategy
fields.help_zh: BY_HEADING 下必填且范围为 1 至 6。小于等于此级数的标题均作为边界；更深标题保留在正文，超长节按段落或句子回退，无标题文档退化为智能切分。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验
fields.name: heading_level

fields.help_en: 1 to 6000 characters. It follows the character length metric of EB and is not the number of tokens. If omitted, the server-side default value is used
fields.help_zh: 1 至 6000 字符，沿用 EB 的字符长度口径，不是 Token 数；省略使用服务端默认值
fields.name: max_chunk_size

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when the strategy is BY_LENGTH. The unit is characters, and the default value is 0. The valid value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the valid maxChunkSize, and the length after overlapping must not exceed the maximum chunk size. Ignored for other strategies and verified by the backend according to the strategy
fields.help_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 生效，单位为字符，缺省为 0；有效值须大于等于 0 且小于有效 maxChunkSize，重叠后仍不超过最大分块长度。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验
fields.name: overlap_size

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
fields.help_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 和邮箱地址
fields.name: remove_urls_and_emails

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive spaces, line breaks, and tabs with a single space
fields.help_zh: 是否将连续空格、换行、制表符替换为单个空格
fields.name: replace_consecutive_whitespace

fields.help_en: The text preprocessing rules before chunking
fields.help_zh: 切分前的文本预处理规则
fields.name: preprocess_rules

fields.help_en: Required and non-empty when the strategy is BY_SEPARATOR. It matches the literal string as a whole and does not use regular expressions. Ignored for other strategies
fields.help_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 下必填且非空，按字面字符串整体匹配，不使用正则；其他策略忽略
fields.name: separator

fields.help_en: Returns the saved chunking strategy. AUTO indicates automatic chunking, and BY_SEPARATOR indicates chunking by separator. BY_LENGTH and BY_HEADING are returned only for compatibility with historical configurations. When creating or updating a configuration, only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are accepted in the first phase
fields.help_zh: 返回已保存的分块策略。AUTO 为自动分块，BY_SEPARATOR 为分隔符分块；BY_LENGTH 和 BY_HEADING 仅为历史配置兼容返回，新建或更新配置时一期仅接受 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en: The valid configuration with parsed default values. It only affects subsequently newly uploaded or explicitly reprocessed assets
fields.help_zh: 已解析默认值的有效配置，仅影响后续新上传或显式重新处理的资产
fields.name: chunk_configuration

fields.help_en: The description of the knowledge base
fields.help_zh: 知识库描述
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: If omitted, the default model dimension of 1024 is used. text-embedding-v3 supports 64, 128, 256, 512, 768, and 1024. text-embedding-v4 supports 64, 128, 256, 512, 768, 1024, 1536, and 2048. qwen3.7-text-embedding supports 256, 512, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048, and 2560. qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash supports 256, 512, 768, and 1024. This cannot be modified after creation
fields.help_zh: 省略时使用模型默认维度 1024。text-embedding-v3 支持 64、128、256、512、768、1024；text-embedding-v4 支持 64、128、256、512、768、1024、1536、2048；qwen3.7-text-embedding 支持 256、512、768、1024、1536、2048、2560；qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash 支持 256、512、768、1024。创建后不可修改
fields.name: embedding_dimension

fields.help_en: Only the listed Model Studio Qwen series models are supported. If omitted, the default value is text-embedding-v4. This cannot be modified after creation. To change the model, you must rebuild the knowledge base
fields.help_zh: 仅支持列出的百炼通义系模型；省略时默认 text-embedding-v4。创建后不可修改，更换模型须重建知识库
fields.name: embedding_model

fields.help_en: The metadata field name of the knowledge base within the workspace. It must be unique within the same schema and cannot occupy system control fields
fields.help_zh: 工作空间内知识库的元数据字段名；同一 schema 中唯一，不得占用系统控制字段
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: STRING, LONG, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, or DATETIME. Uploaded and updated string values are parsed by the backend according to this type. Nested objects are not accepted
fields.help_zh: STRING、LONG、DOUBLE、BOOLEAN 或 DATETIME。上传和更新的字符串 value 由后端按此类型解析；不接受嵌套对象
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The fixed value or system variable name. The following variables are retained: DOCUMENT_NAME, FILE_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_URI, and SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME. DOCUMENT_* refers to the original asset in this operation, and the variable names retain EB compatibility
fields.help_zh: 固定值或系统变量名。沿用 DOCUMENT_NAME、FILE_TYPE、FILE_SIZE、DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME、SOURCE_TYPE、SOURCE_URI、SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME；DOCUMENT_* 在本接口中指资产原件，变量名保留 EB 兼容性
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: CONSTANT indicates a constant. If the value is not empty, the system uses a fixed value. If no value is configured, the system assigns the value during upload. SYSTEM_VARIABLE indicates that the system generates the value and customers cannot overwrite it. You cannot modify the schema after creation
fields.help_zh: CONSTANT 表示常量：value 非空时使用固定值，未配置值时由上传赋值；SYSTEM_VARIABLE 表示由系统生成，客户不得覆盖。schema 创建后不可修改
fields.name: value_mode

fields.help_en: Declares the metadata fields that can be used by assets. This cannot be modified after creation. If omitted, user metadata is not used
fields.help_zh: 声明资产可使用的元数据字段，创建后不可修改；省略表示不使用用户元数据
fields.name: metadata_schema

fields.help_en: The name of the knowledge base within the workspace
fields.help_zh: 工作空间内的知识库名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The retrieve mode. KEYWORD indicates keyword retrieve, VECTOR indicates AISearch, and HYBRID indicates hybrid retrieve. The request parameter takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, HYBRID is used
fields.help_zh: KEYWORD 为关键词检索，VECTOR 为向量检索，HYBRID 为混合检索。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 HYBRID
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The rank fusion algorithm. RRF indicates reciprocal rank fusion, and WEIGHTED indicates weighted normalization fusion. This parameter takes effect only when the search mode is HYBRID. The default value is RRF
fields.help_zh: RRF 为倒数排名融合，WEIGHTED 为加权归一融合。仅 HYBRID 生效，系统默认 RRF
fields.name: rank_algorithm

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable reranking by default. This parameter applies to all three search modes. The request parameter takes precedence over this configuration. If neither is configured, the default value is false
fields.help_zh: 适用于三种检索模式；请求显式指定时覆盖本配置，均未配置时为 false
fields.name: rerank_enabled

fields.help_en: The reranking model. Supported models include qwen3-rerank, qwen3.7-text-rerank, gte-rerank-v2, and qwen3-vl-rerank. The request parameter takes precedence over this configuration. If neither is configured, qwen3-rerank is used
fields.help_zh: 支持 qwen3-rerank、qwen3.7-text-rerank、gte-rerank-v2、qwen3-vl-rerank；请求优先于本配置，均未配置时使用 qwen3-rerank
fields.name: rerank_model

fields.help_en: The k parameter for RRF. The default value is 60. The value must be greater than 0
fields.help_zh: RRF 的 k 参数，系统默认 60，必须大于 0
fields.name: rrf_k

fields.help_en: The default number of results to return. A maximum of 100 results can be returned. The request parameter takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, 10 is used. The actual number of returned results may be less than this value after filtering by permissions and published versions
fields.help_zh: 最多返回 100 条。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 10；权限和发布版本过滤后可能不足该数量
fields.name: topk

fields.help_en: The vector path weight for WEIGHTED. The default value is 0.7. The keyword path weight is 1 minus this value
fields.help_zh: WEIGHTED 的向量路权重，系统默认 0.7，关键词路权重为 1 减去此值
fields.name: vector_weight

fields.help_en: The default search configuration at the knowledge base level. This configuration takes effect when the corresponding parameters are not provided in the search request. You can modify it by calling UpdateKnowledgeBase
fields.help_zh: 知识库级默认检索配置，检索请求未传对应参数时生效，可通过 UpdateKnowledgeBase 修改
fields.name: search_configuration

parameters.help_en: The request parameters for creating a knowledge base
parameters.help_zh: 创建知识库的请求参数
parameters.name: body

data.description_en: The details of the knowledge base that has entered the creation process, including the tenant ownership, status, and lastError. You can call the GetKnowledgeBase or ListKnowledgeBases operation to query the creation result
data.description_zh: 进入创建流程的知识库详情，包含租户归属、status 和 lastError；通过 GetKnowledgeBase 或 ListKnowledgeBases 查询创建结果

chunkConfiguration.description_en: The valid configuration with parsed default values. It only affects subsequently newly uploaded or explicitly reprocessed assets
chunkConfiguration.description_zh: 已解析默认值的有效配置，仅影响后续新上传或显式重新处理的资产

headingLevel.description_en: Required when the strategy is BY_HEADING, and the value ranges from 1 to 6. Headings at or below this level are used as boundaries. Deeper headings are retained in the body text. Overlong sections fall back to paragraphs or sentences, and documents without headings fall back to intelligent chunking. Ignored for other strategies and verified by the backend according to the strategy
headingLevel.description_zh: BY_HEADING 下必填且范围为 1 至 6。小于等于此级数的标题均作为边界；更深标题保留在正文，超长节按段落或句子回退，无标题文档退化为智能切分。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

maxChunkSize.description_en: 1 to 6000 characters. It follows the character length metric of EB and is not the number of tokens. If omitted, the server-side default value is used
maxChunkSize.description_zh: 1 至 6000 字符，沿用 EB 的字符长度口径，不是 Token 数；省略使用服务端默认值

overlapSize.description_en: Takes effect only when the strategy is BY_LENGTH. The unit is characters, and the default value is 0. The valid value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the valid maxChunkSize, and the length after overlapping must not exceed the maximum chunk size. Ignored for other strategies and verified by the backend according to the strategy
overlapSize.description_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 生效，单位为字符，缺省为 0；有效值须大于等于 0 且小于有效 maxChunkSize，重叠后仍不超过最大分块长度。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

preprocessRules.description_en: The text preprocessing rules before chunking
preprocessRules.description_zh: 切分前的文本预处理规则

removeUrlsAndEmails.description_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
removeUrlsAndEmails.description_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 和邮箱地址

replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive spaces, line breaks, and tabs with a single space
replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_zh: 是否将连续空格、换行、制表符替换为单个空格

separator.description_en: Required and non-empty when the strategy is BY_SEPARATOR. It matches the literal string as a whole and does not use regular expressions. Ignored for other strategies
separator.description_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 下必填且非空，按字面字符串整体匹配，不使用正则；其他策略忽略

strategy.description_en: Returns the saved chunking strategy. AUTO indicates automatic chunking, and BY_SEPARATOR indicates chunking by separator. BY_LENGTH and BY_HEADING are returned only for compatibility with historical configurations. When creating or updating a configuration, only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are accepted in the first phase
strategy.description_zh: 返回已保存的分块策略。AUTO 为自动分块，BY_SEPARATOR 为分隔符分块；BY_LENGTH 和 BY_HEADING 仅为历史配置兼容返回，新建或更新配置时一期仅接受 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR

createdAt.description_en: The time in ISO 8601 UTC format

embeddingDimension.description_en: The actual effective vector dimensions. Default value: 1024. It cannot be modified after creation
embeddingDimension.description_zh: 实际生效的向量维度，默认 1024，创建后不可修改

embeddingModel.description_en: The actual effective model name. It cannot be modified after creation. Default value: text-embedding-v4
embeddingModel.description_zh: 实际生效的模型名称，创建后不可修改；默认 text-embedding-v4

enumValueTitles.qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash: 通义文本向量极速模型 3.7（qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash）
enumValueTitles.text-embedding-v3: 通义文本向量模型 v3（text-embedding-v3）
enumValueTitles.text-embedding-v4: 通义文本向量模型 v4（text-embedding-v4）

knowledgeBaseId.description_en: The stable knowledge base ID generated by the platform, which is persistently bound to the tenantId and workspaceId. Queries and modifications must verify all three identifiers simultaneously. Access based solely on the ID is not allowed
knowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 平台生成的稳定知识库 ID，持久化绑定 tenantId 和 workspaceId；查询和变更必须同时校验三者，不得仅凭 ID 访问

lastError.description_en: The sanitized error summary when a lifecycle operation fails
lastError.description_zh: 生命周期操作失败时的脱敏错误摘要

code.description_en: The stable product error code. It does not include internal task identifiers, stack traces, or storage addresses
code.description_zh: 稳定的产品错误码；不返回内部任务标识、堆栈或存储地址

message.description_en: The sanitized error summary that can be displayed to users
message.description_zh: 可向用户展示的脱敏错误摘要

metadataSchema.description_en: The metadata schema is determined during creation and cannot be modified afterward. It contains configurations for constants or system variables
metadataSchema.description_zh: 创建时确定，创建后不可修改；包含常量或系统变量配置

name.description_en: The metadata field name of the knowledge base within the workspace. It must be unique within the same schema and cannot occupy system control fields
name.description_zh: 工作空间内知识库的元数据字段名；同一 schema 中唯一，不得占用系统控制字段

type.description_en: STRING, LONG, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, or DATETIME. Uploaded and updated string values are parsed by the backend according to this type. Nested objects are not accepted
type.description_zh: STRING、LONG、DOUBLE、BOOLEAN 或 DATETIME。上传和更新的字符串 value 由后端按此类型解析；不接受嵌套对象

value.description_en: The fixed value or system variable name. The following variables are retained: DOCUMENT_NAME, FILE_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_URI, and SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME. DOCUMENT_* refers to the original asset in this operation, and the variable names retain EB compatibility
value.description_zh: 固定值或系统变量名。沿用 DOCUMENT_NAME、FILE_TYPE、FILE_SIZE、DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME、SOURCE_TYPE、SOURCE_URI、SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME；DOCUMENT_* 在本接口中指资产原件，变量名保留 EB 兼容性

valueMode.description_en: CONSTANT indicates a constant. If the value is not empty, the system uses a fixed value. If no value is configured, the system assigns the value during upload. SYSTEM_VARIABLE indicates that the system generates the value and customers cannot overwrite it. You cannot modify the schema after creation
valueMode.description_zh: CONSTANT 表示常量：value 非空时使用固定值，未配置值时由上传赋值；SYSTEM_VARIABLE 表示由系统生成，客户不得覆盖。schema 创建后不可修改

name.description_en: The display name of the knowledge base

regionId.description_en: The region where the knowledge base is located. This region is the same as that of the associated workspace and is maintained by the server
regionId.description_zh: 知识库所在地域，与所属工作空间一致，由服务端维护

searchConfiguration.description_en: The valid search configuration with parsed platform default values, which can be overridden by a single search request
searchConfiguration.description_zh: 已解析平台默认值的有效检索配置，可由单次检索请求覆盖

mode.description_en: KEYWORD indicates keyword retrieve, VECTOR indicates AISearch, and HYBRID indicates hybrid retrieve. The request configuration takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, HYBRID is used
mode.description_zh: KEYWORD 为关键词检索，VECTOR 为向量检索，HYBRID 为混合检索。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 HYBRID

rankAlgorithm.description_en: The rank fusion algorithm. RRF indicates reciprocal rank fusion, and WEIGHTED indicates weighted normalization fusion. This parameter takes effect only when the search mode is HYBRID. The default value is RRF
rankAlgorithm.description_zh: RRF 为倒数排名融合，WEIGHTED 为加权归一融合。仅 HYBRID 生效，系统默认 RRF

rerankEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable reranking by default. This parameter applies to all three search modes. The request parameter takes precedence over this configuration. If neither is configured, the default value is false
rerankEnabled.description_zh: 适用于三种检索模式；请求显式指定时覆盖本配置，均未配置时为 false

rerankModel.description_en: The reranking model. Supported models include qwen3-rerank, qwen3.7-text-rerank, gte-rerank-v2, and qwen3-vl-rerank. The request parameter takes precedence over this configuration. If neither is configured, qwen3-rerank is used
rerankModel.description_zh: 支持 qwen3-rerank、qwen3.7-text-rerank、gte-rerank-v2、qwen3-vl-rerank；请求优先于本配置，均未配置时使用 qwen3-rerank

enumValueTitles.gte-rerank-v2: 通用文本重排模型 v2（gte-rerank-v2）

rrfK.description_en: The k parameter for RRF. The default value is 60. The value must be greater than 0
rrfK.description_zh: RRF 的 k 参数，系统默认 60，必须大于 0

topK.description_en: The default number of results to return. A maximum of 100 results can be returned. The request parameter takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, 10 is used. The actual number of returned results may be less than this value after filtering by permissions and published versions
topK.description_zh: 最多返回 100 条。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 10；权限和发布版本过滤后可能不足该数量

vectorWeight.description_en: The vector path weight for WEIGHTED. The default value is 0.7. The keyword path weight is 1 minus this value
vectorWeight.description_zh: WEIGHTED 的向量路权重，系统默认 0.7，关键词路权重为 1 减去此值

status.description_en: You can call the GetKnowledgeBase and ListKnowledgeBases operations to query the creation progress. Creating indicates that the creation is in progress, Active indicates that the creation is successful, and CreateFailed indicates that the creation failed. The deletion acceptance response may return Deleting, DeleteFailed, or Deleted. After the deletion is accepted, GetKnowledgeBase returns that the resource does not exist, and ListKnowledgeBases no longer displays the resource while the backend continues to clean it up. For the cause of a creation failure, see lastError
status.description_zh: GetKnowledgeBase 和 ListKnowledgeBases 可查询创建进度：Creating 为创建中，Active 为创建成功，CreateFailed 为创建失败。删除受理响应可返回 Deleting、DeleteFailed 或 Deleted；删除受理后 GetKnowledgeBase 返回资源不存在，ListKnowledgeBases 不再显示该资源，后台继续清理。创建失败原因见 lastError

tenantId.description_en: The read-only tenant ownership. It is resolved by Magic based on the trusted gateway call identity and bound during creation, which is consistent with the tenant of the workspace to which it belongs. Client-specified or modified values are not accepted
tenantId.description_zh: 只读租户归属，由 Magic 根据可信网关调用身份解析并在创建时绑定，与所属工作空间的租户一致；不接受客户端指定或修改

updatedAt.description_en: The time in ISO 8601 UTC format

workspaceId.description_en: The AgentCore workspace to which the resource belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AgentCore 工作空间

message.description_en: The description of the data masking result

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
